name: Esper Wing
description: You slash out with aura-enriched wings. Make a ranged attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Esper Wing results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s. With each successful hit from this move, increase your movement speed by 5ft until you are incapacitated, are switched out, or the combat ends (Maximum of +30ft to movement speed).
